def ik(pos,R,seed=None):
 q=(d.qpos[jq].copy() if seed is None else seed.copy())
 for it in range(150):
  d.qpos[jq]=q; mujoco.mj_forward(m,d)
  ep=pos-d.xpos[body]
  er=Rotation.from_matrix(R@d.xmat[body].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
  jp=np.zeros((3,m.nv)); jr=np.zeros((3,m.nv)); mujoco.mj_jacBody(m,d,jp,jr,body)
  J=np.vstack([jp[:,s._jv[:7]], .2*jr[:,s._jv[:7]]]); e=np.r_[ep,.2*er]
  dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+0.0005*np.eye(6),e)
  dq=np.clip(dq,-.12,.12); q+=dq
  q=np.clip(q,s.lower[:7],s.upper[:7])
  if np.linalg.norm(ep)<.001 and np.linalg.norm(er)<.01: break
 d.qpos[jq]=q; mujoco.mj_forward(m,d)
 print('IK it',it,'err',np.linalg.norm(pos-d.xpos[body]),np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(R@d.xmat[body].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()), 'q',q)
